::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** 12th Sept. 1865  
**Manuscript:** Copy outletter book British Library Add MSS. 55384 (2): P. 860
:::

Dear Madam,
[I](people/person_379.qmd) am not aware whether “[The Clever Woman](cmy_books/cmybook_58.qmd)” has been translated, but perhaps you will answer the enclosed yourself.

Dear Madam
Yours faithfully
Geo: Lillie Craik
